_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd holdfast/egg-holdfast-na-w.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence) and the launch line of CM2Walki/HoldfastNaW. Octail rewrites most of it: the server is installed in the server folder and started there; upstream's hard-coded public IP (-l 94.130.66.231) and fixed -o port, its third-party image and its git clone of someone's config repository are gone. The server reads serverconfig_octail.txt, a copy of the shipped serverconfig_default.txt made at install (updates overwrite the default), and Octail sets the name, welcome message, region, admin password, game port, Steam query port and (when the file has it) the Steam communications port before every start with the file parser; the install adds any of those keys the file lacks. The join password is written or commented out by the start line, so an empty one means no password. Query and communications ports come from automatic port variables (+1 and +2), the Steam query (A2S) gives the player count, the log goes to the console (-logFile -), the stop is Ctrl+C (SIGINT, as the CM2 image's stop signal), the no_console_input flag hides the command box (the server takes admin commands in game, F1, with the admin password), the start also counts once the game port (UDP) is bound, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Holdfast: Nations At War
author: ankit@bmghosting.com
description: Holdfast: Nations At War is a competitive multiplayer first and third person shooter set in the Napoleonic era, with over 150 players per server.
startup: sed -i -E "s/^#? *server_password( .*)?$/$([ -n "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" ] && echo "server_password {{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" || echo '#server_password')/" serverconfig_octail.txt; "./Holdfast NaW" -startserver -batchmode -nographics --serverheadless -screen-width 640 -screen-height 480 -screen-quality Fastest -framerate {{SERVER_FPS}} -serverConfigFilePath serverconfig_octail.txt -logFile - -logArchivesDirectory logs_archive/ -p {{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SteamCMD installation script (Octail)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Variables: SRCDS_APPID (the app), SRCDS_BETAID / SRCDS_BETAPASS (a beta branch), anonymous login.

## anonymous login: these servers need no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Holdfast NaW" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Holdfast: Nations At War dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x "/mnt/server/Holdfast NaW"

## Octail: the server reads serverconfig_octail.txt, a copy of the shipped serverconfig_default.txt that game updates
## don't overwrite. The keys Octail sets before every start must be there (the line parser only replaces lines).
cd /mnt/server || exit 1
mkdir -p logs_archive
if [[ ! -f serverconfig_octail.txt ]]; then
    if [[ -f serverconfig_default.txt ]]; then cp serverconfig_default.txt serverconfig_octail.txt; else : > serverconfig_octail.txt; fi
fi
for key in server_name server_welcome_message server_region server_admin_password server_port steam_query_port \
    steam_communications_port; do
    if ! grep -qE "^${key} " serverconfig_octail.txt; then
        { echo "${key} -"; cat serverconfig_octail.txt; } > serverconfig_octail.txt.new && mv serverconfig_octail.txt.new serverconfig_octail.txt
    fi
done
if ! grep -qE '^#? *server_password' serverconfig_octail.txt; then
    { echo '#server_password'; cat serverconfig_octail.txt; } > serverconfig_octail.txt.new && mv serverconfig_octail.txt.new serverconfig_octail.txt
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser.

variables.name: Welcome Message
variables.description: The message players see in the chat when they join.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: The region the server browser lists the server under: europe, usa, australia, brazil, china, japan, russia or southkorea.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: The password for the in-game admin login (F1, then rc login <password>).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password.

variables.name: Server FPS
variables.description: The server's frame rate cap (higher = smoother hits, more CPU).

variables.name: Steam Query Port
variables.description: Set by Octail when the server is created (one after the game port). The server browser and the player count use it.

variables.name: Steam Communications Port
variables.description: Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port); written to the config when it has a steam_communications_port line.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Holdfast: Nations At War - Dedicated Server.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server at every start.
